elements_selected.content: Upgrade both cache files to version 2 with Merkle fields per §12. index.json v2: increment CACHE_VERSION to 2, add merkle_root: String (hex ContentHash) to each file entry, add vault_root_hash: String at top level. theory.json v2: increment THEORY_CACHE_VERSION to 2, add vault_root_hash: String, built_at: String (RFC3339), spl_blocks: HashMap<String, SplBlockCache> where key is 'path:line' and value has ast_hash, content_hash, section_heading, section_grounding_hash, explicit_groundings fields per §12.2. When loading a v1 cache, return None (force full re-index/rebuild on first run after upgrade). When loading a v2 cache with missing merkle_root fields, treat that file as needing reparse. The git_commit/git_dirty fields in theory.json are Option<String>/Option<bool> per §1.6 and are absent in index.json per the VCS boundary contract. Implement FileMerkle serialisation/deserialisation as part of the cache schema.
